name: DOG X BLOODS
source:
The story of DOGXBLOODS revolves around a protagonist who is plagued by misfortune. While attending a funeral, the protagonist meets a silver fox who claims to be the "Qianbei" and, under his guidance, is able to avoid disaster. Finally, the protagonist catches a break and explores the reasons behind their run of bad luck.

[From [url=https://wetdogs.itch.io/dog-x-bloods]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《DOGXBLOODS》的故事围绕着一位遭受不幸的主人公展开。主人公在参加葬礼时，遇见了一只自称“黔北”的银狐，在他的指引下，才得以化险为夷。最后，主角喘口气，探究自己运气不佳的原因。

[来自[url=https://wetdogs.itch.io/dog-x-bloods]Itch.io[/url]]
